name: Audio Mix
description: Balances and mixes audio streams for the final output, against the measured level of the bed that was chosen.

inputs.name: audio_spine
inputs.description: State input: audio_spine (the timed audio spine with structure and music_behavior)

inputs.name: music_selection
inputs.description: State input: music_selection - the chosen bed. Read for `measurements`: a music_behavior is a RELATIVE dB applied to whatever level the file already carries, so the bed's own integrated loudness is what decides whether the planned offset lands.

inputs.name: a_roll_assignments
inputs.description: The source ranges the edit really plays, which is what makes the speech measurable: step 5.02 runs one ffmpeg loudnorm pass per block over them and records speech_lufs and the separation each window will deliver (library/tools/speech_loudness.py). Optional because a spec without it is still a whole spec - every window then records speech_lufs as an admitted absence rather than a level. Declared WITH its reader, per AGENTS.md 10.4.

outputs.name: audio_mix_spec
outputs.description: State output: audio_mix_spec - the track levels, the per-block music automation with the clip gain and where it puts the measured bed, what the bed measures, and the separation target, which is undeclared.
